import { Event } from '../lib/google-sheets';
import { CityPriceConfig } from '../lib/cities';
export type IndexedEvent = Event & {
  parsedHour: number;
  parsedPrice: number | null;
  isFreeOrDonationPrice: boolean;
  searchCorpus: string;
  activeDays: boolean[];
};
export type ContactInfo =
  | {
      type: 'email';
      email: string;
      mailtoUrl: string;
      gmailUrl: string;
    }
  | {
      type: 'phone';
      displayPhone: string;
      telUrl: string;
      rawPhone: string;
    }
  | {
      type: 'url';
      url: string;
    }
  | {
      type: 'none';
    };
export function parseHour(timeStr: string): number {
  if (!timeStr) return 18;
  const cleaned = timeStr.trim().toLowerCase();
  const match = cleaned.match(/(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(am|pm|a|p)?/i);
  if (match) {
    let hour = parseInt(match[1], 10);
    const minute = match[2] ? parseInt(match[2], 10) : 0;
    const meridian = match[3];
    if (meridian) {
      const isPm = meridian.startsWith('p');
      const isAm = meridian.startsWith('a');
      if (isPm && hour < 12) hour += 12;
      if (isAm && hour === 12) hour = 0;
    } else {
      if (hour >= 1 && hour <= 6) {
        hour += 12;
      }
    }
    return hour + minute / 60;
  }
  const numMatch = cleaned.match(/\d+/);
  return numMatch ? parseInt(numMatch[0], 10) : 18;
}
export function formatTimeLabel(timeStr: string): string {
  if (!timeStr) return '';
  const cleaned = timeStr.trim();
  const match = cleaned.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(am|pm|a|p)?$/i);
  if (match) {
    const hour = match[1];
    const minute = match[2] && match[2] !== '00' ? `:${match[2]}` : '';
    const meridian = (match[3] || 'p').toLowerCase().startsWith('a') ? 'a' : 'p';
    return `${hour}${minute}${meridian}`;
  }
  return cleaned;
}
export function formatTimeRange(
  startTime: string,
  endTime: string
): { start: string; end?: string } {
  const start = formatTimeLabel(startTime);
  const end = endTime ? formatTimeLabel(endTime) : undefined;
  return { start, end };
}
export function formatRecurrenceText(
  frequency?: string,
  frequencyNotes?: string
): string {
  const freq = (frequency || '').trim();
  const notes = (frequencyNotes || '').trim();
  if (freq && notes) {
    if (notes.startsWith(',') || notes.startsWith('.')) {
      return `${freq}${notes}`;
    }
    return `${freq} ${notes}`;
  }
  return freq || notes || '';
}
export function isFreePrice(price: string): boolean {
  if (!price) return true;
  const p = price.trim().toLowerCase();
  return p.startsWith('free') || p.startsWith('gratis') || p === '0' || p === '$0';
}
export function isFreeOrDonation(price: string): boolean {
  if (!price) return true;
  const p = price.trim().toLowerCase();
  return (
    isFreePrice(p) ||
    p.includes('donation') ||
    p.includes('aporte') ||
    p.includes('voluntari') ||
    p === '0k'
  );
}
export function parseEventPrice(priceStr: string, currencyCode: string = 'USD'): number | null {
  if (!priceStr) return 0;
  const cleaned = priceStr.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (isFreeOrDonation(cleaned)) return 0;
  if (currencyCode === 'COP') {
    const kMatch = cleaned.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*k/i);
    if (kMatch) {
      return parseFloat(kMatch[1]);
    }
    const thousandSepMatch = cleaned.match(/(\d{1,3})[.,](\d{3})/);
    if (thousandSepMatch) {
      const whole = parseInt(thousandSepMatch[1], 10);
      const frac = parseInt(thousandSepMatch[2], 10) / 1000;
      return whole + frac;
    }
    const bigNumMatch = cleaned.match(/\b(\d{4,6})\b/);
    if (bigNumMatch) {
      return parseInt(bigNumMatch[1], 10) / 1000;
    }
    const smallNumMatch = cleaned.match(/\b(\d{1,3})\b/);
    if (smallNumMatch) {
      return parseInt(smallNumMatch[1], 10);
    }
    return null;
  }
  const usdMatch = cleaned.match(/\$?\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);
  if (usdMatch) {
    return parseFloat(usdMatch[1]);
  }
  return null;
}
export function matchesPriceFilter(
  eventPrice: string,
  maxPriceFilter: number,
  priceConfig: CityPriceConfig
): boolean {
  if (maxPriceFilter >= priceConfig.maxPrice) {
    return true;
  }
  if (isFreeOrDonation(eventPrice)) {
    return true;
  }
  if (maxPriceFilter === 0) {
    return isFreeOrDonation(eventPrice);
  }
  const num = parseEventPrice(eventPrice, priceConfig.currencyCode);
  if (num === null) {
    return false;
  }
  return num <= maxPriceFilter;
}
export function formatPriceValue(val: number, config: CityPriceConfig): string {
  if (val === 0) return 'Free';
  if (config.unitSuffix) {
    return `${val}${config.unitSuffix}`;
  }
  return `${config.currencySymbol}${val}`;
}
export function formatPriceReadout(val: number, config: CityPriceConfig): string {
  if (val === 0) return 'Free / donation';
  if (val === config.underValue) return config.underLabel;
  if (val >= config.maxPrice) return 'Any price';
  return `Up to ${formatPriceValue(val, config)}`;
}
export function formatPriceTriggerLabel(val: number, config: CityPriceConfig): string {
  if (val >= config.maxPrice) return 'All prices';
  if (val === 0) return 'Free / donation';
  if (val === config.underValue) return config.underLabel;
  return `Up to ${formatPriceValue(val, config)}`;
}
const DAY_ALIAS_MAP: Record<string, string[]> = {
  sun: ['sun', 'sunday'],
  sunday: ['sun', 'sunday'],
  mon: ['mon', 'monday'],
  monday: ['mon', 'monday'],
  tue: ['tue', 'tues', 'tuesday'],
  tuesday: ['tue', 'tues', 'tuesday'],
  wed: ['wed', 'weds', 'wednesday'],
  wednesday: ['wed', 'weds', 'wednesday'],
  thu: ['thu', 'thur', 'thurs', 'thursday'],
  thursday: ['thu', 'thur', 'thurs', 'thursday'],
  fri: ['fri', 'friday'],
  friday: ['fri', 'friday'],
  sat: ['sat', 'saturday'],
  saturday: ['sat', 'saturday'],
};
const DAY_INDEX: Record<string, number> = {
  sun: 0,
  sunday: 0,
  mon: 1,
  monday: 1,
  tue: 2,
  tues: 2,
  tuesday: 2,
  wed: 3,
  weds: 3,
  wednesday: 3,
  thu: 4,
  thur: 4,
  thurs: 4,
  thursday: 4,
  fri: 5,
  friday: 5,
  sat: 6,
  saturday: 6,
};
export function normalizeDayOfWeek(dayStr: string): string {
  if (!dayStr) return '';
  const trimmed = dayStr.trim();
  const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
  if (lower.includes('daily') || lower.includes('everyday') || lower.includes('every day')) {
    return 'Daily';
  }
  const tokens = trimmed.split(/[^a-zA-Z]+/).filter(Boolean);
  const DAY_TO_SHORT: Record<string, string> = {
    sun: 'Sun',
    sunday: 'Sun',
    mon: 'Mon',
    monday: 'Mon',
    tue: 'Tue',
    tues: 'Tue',
    tuesday: 'Tue',
    wed: 'Wed',
    weds: 'Wed',
    wednesday: 'Wed',
    thu: 'Thu',
    thur: 'Thu',
    thurs: 'Thu',
    thursday: 'Thu',
    fri: 'Fri',
    friday: 'Fri',
    sat: 'Sat',
    saturday: 'Sat',
  };
  const normalized: string[] = [];
  for (const token of tokens) {
    const short = DAY_TO_SHORT[token.toLowerCase()];
    if (short && !normalized.includes(short)) {
      normalized.push(short);
    }
  }
  return normalized.length > 0 ? normalized.join(', ') : trimmed;
}
export function matchesDay(eventDays: string, targetDayName: string): boolean {
  if (!eventDays || !targetDayName) return false;
  const targetKey = targetDayName.trim().toLowerCase();
  const targetIndex = DAY_INDEX[targetKey];
  const aliases = DAY_ALIAS_MAP[targetKey] || [targetKey];
  const rawLower = eventDays.toLowerCase();
  if (rawLower.includes('daily') || rawLower.includes('everyday') || rawLower.includes('every day')) {
    return true;
  }
  if (rawLower.includes(targetKey)) {
    return true;
  }
  const tokens = rawLower.split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (tokens.some((token) => aliases.includes(token))) {
    return true;
  }
  const rangeMatch = rawLower.match(/([a-zA-Z]+)\s*(?:[\u2013\u2014\-]|to)\s*([a-zA-Z]+)/);
  if (rangeMatch && targetIndex !== undefined) {
    const d1 = DAY_INDEX[rangeMatch[1].toLowerCase()];
    const d2 = DAY_INDEX[rangeMatch[2].toLowerCase()];
    if (d1 !== undefined && d2 !== undefined) {
      if (d1 <= d2) {
        return targetIndex >= d1 && targetIndex <= d2;
      }
      return targetIndex >= d1 || targetIndex <= d2;
    }
  }
  return false;
}
const MONTH_NAME_TO_NUM: Record<string, number> = {
  jan: 1, january: 1, enero: 1, ene: 1,
  feb: 2, february: 2, febrero: 2,
  mar: 3, march: 3, marzo: 3,
  apr: 4, april: 4, abril: 4, abr: 4,
  may: 5, mayo: 5,
  jun: 6, june: 6, junio: 6,
  jul: 7, july: 7, julio: 7,
  aug: 8, august: 8, agosto: 8, ago: 8,
  sep: 9, sept: 9, september: 9, septiembre: 9, setiembre: 9, set: 9,
  oct: 10, october: 10, octubre: 10,
  nov: 11, november: 11, noviembre: 11,
  dec: 12, december: 12, diciembre: 12, dic: 12,
};
export function isMonthActive(frequencyNotes?: string, targetDate: Date = new Date()): boolean {
  if (!frequencyNotes) return true;
  const cleaned = frequencyNotes.trim();
  if (!cleaned) return true;
  if (/\b(?:irregular|hiatus|paused|cancelled|canceled|on hold|inactive|tbd)\b/i.test(cleaned)) {
    return false;
  }
  const targetMonth = targetDate.getMonth() + 1;
  if (/\b(?:even\s*months?|months?[\s,]+even|meses\s*pares)\b/i.test(cleaned)) {
    return targetMonth % 2 === 0;
  }
  if (/\b(?:odd\s*months?|months?[\s,]+odd|meses\s*impares)\b/i.test(cleaned)) {
    return targetMonth % 2 !== 0;
  }
  const exceptMatch = cleaned.match(
    /\b(?:except|excluding|no meetings? in|off in)\s+([a-zA-Z]+)(?:\s*(?:and|&|,)\s*([a-zA-Z]+))?\b/i
  );
  if (exceptMatch) {
    const m1 = MONTH_NAME_TO_NUM[exceptMatch[1].toLowerCase()];
    const m2 = exceptMatch[2] ? MONTH_NAME_TO_NUM[exceptMatch[2].toLowerCase()] : null;
    if (m1 && targetMonth === m1) return false;
    if (m2 && targetMonth === m2) return false;
  }
  const rangeMatch = cleaned.match(
    /\b([a-zA-Z]{3,9})\s*(?:[\u2013\u2014\-]|--|\bto\b|\bthrough\b|\bthru\b|\ba\b)\s*([a-zA-Z]{3,9})\b/i
  );
  if (rangeMatch) {
    const startMonth = MONTH_NAME_TO_NUM[rangeMatch[1].toLowerCase()];
    const endMonth = MONTH_NAME_TO_NUM[rangeMatch[2].toLowerCase()];
    if (startMonth && endMonth) {
      if (startMonth <= endMonth) {
        return targetMonth >= startMonth && targetMonth <= endMonth;
      }
      return targetMonth >= startMonth || targetMonth <= endMonth;
    }
  }
  const singleMonthMatch = cleaned.match(/\b([a-zA-Z]{3,9})\s+only\b/i);
  if (singleMonthMatch) {
    const m = MONTH_NAME_TO_NUM[singleMonthMatch[1].toLowerCase()];
    if (m) {
      return targetMonth === m;
    }
  }
  if (/\bsummer\b/i.test(cleaned)) {
    return targetMonth >= 6 && targetMonth <= 8;
  }
  if (/\bwinter\b/i.test(cleaned)) {
    return targetMonth === 12 || targetMonth <= 2;
  }
  if (/\bspring\b/i.test(cleaned)) {
    return targetMonth >= 3 && targetMonth <= 5;
  }
  if (/\b(?:fall|autumn)\b/i.test(cleaned)) {
    return targetMonth >= 9 && targetMonth <= 11;
  }
  return true;
}
export function getWeekdayOccurrence(targetDate: Date): {
  occurrence: number;
  isLast: boolean;
} {
  const dayOfMonth = targetDate.getDate();
  const occurrence = Math.ceil(dayOfMonth / 7);
  const daysInMonth = new Date(
    targetDate.getFullYear(),
    targetDate.getMonth() + 1,
    0
  ).getDate();
  const isLast = dayOfMonth + 7 > daysInMonth;
  return { occurrence, isLast };
}
function getWeekNumber(d: Date): number {
  const target = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate()));
  const dayNum = target.getUTCDay() || 7;
  target.setUTCDate(target.getUTCDate() + 4 - dayNum);
  const yearStart = new Date(Date.UTC(target.getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1));
  return Math.ceil(((target.getTime() - yearStart.getTime()) / 86400000 + 1) / 7);
}
export function isEventActiveOnDate(event: Event, targetDate: Date): boolean {
  const combinedText = `${event.frequency || ''} ${event.frequencyNotes || ''}`.trim();
  if (/\b(?:irregular|hiatus|paused|cancelled|canceled|on hold|inactive|tbd)\b/i.test(combinedText)) {
    return false;
  }
  if (!isMonthActive(event.frequencyNotes, targetDate) || !isMonthActive(event.frequency, targetDate)) {
    return false;
  }
  const DAY_NAMES = ['Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday'];
  const targetDayName = DAY_NAMES[targetDate.getDay()];
  const daySpec = `${event.dayOfWeek || ''} ${event.frequency || ''}`;
  if (!matchesDay(daySpec, targetDayName)) {
    return false;
  }
  if (/\b(?:even\s*weeks?|weeks?[\s,]+even)\b/i.test(combinedText)) {
    const weekNum = getWeekNumber(targetDate);
    if (weekNum % 2 !== 0) return false;
  }
  if (/\b(?:odd\s*weeks?|weeks?[\s,]+odd)\b/i.test(combinedText)) {
    const weekNum = getWeekNumber(targetDate);
    if (weekNum % 2 === 0) return false;
  }
  const { occurrence, isLast } = getWeekdayOccurrence(targetDate);
  const has1st = /\b(1st|first|primer[oa]?)\b/i.test(combinedText);
  const has2nd = /\b(2nd|second|segund[oa])\b/i.test(combinedText);
  const has3rd = /\b(3rd|third|tercer[oa]?)\b/i.test(combinedText);
  const has4th = /\b(4th|fourth|cuart[oa])\b/i.test(combinedText);
  const has5th = /\b(5th|fifth|quint[oa])\b/i.test(combinedText);
  const hasLast = /\b(last|ultimo|últim[oa])\b/i.test(combinedText);
  if (has1st || has2nd || has3rd || has4th || has5th || hasLast) {
    const matchesOrdinal =
      (has1st && occurrence === 1) ||
      (has2nd && occurrence === 2) ||
      (has3rd && occurrence === 3) ||
      (has4th && occurrence === 4) ||
      (has5th && occurrence === 5) ||
      (hasLast && isLast);
    return matchesOrdinal;
  }
  const cadence = (event.frequency || '').toLowerCase();
  if (cadence.includes('bi-weekly')) {
    const weekNum = getWeekNumber(targetDate);
    return weekNum % 2 === 0;
  }
  return true;
}
export function ensureExternalUrl(url: string): string {
  if (!url) return '';
  const trimmed = url.trim();
  if (/^(https?:\/\/|mailto:|tel:|sms:)/i.test(trimmed)) return trimmed;
  return `https://${trimmed}`;
}
export function formatPhoneNumber(phone: string): string {
  const digits = phone.replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (digits.length === 10) {
    return `(${digits.slice(0, 3)}) ${digits.slice(3, 6)}-${digits.slice(6)}`;
  }
  if (digits.length === 11 && digits.startsWith('1')) {
    return `(${digits.slice(1, 4)}) ${digits.slice(4, 7)}-${digits.slice(7)}`;
  }
  return phone;
}
export function parseContactInfo(rawContact?: string): ContactInfo {
  if (!rawContact) return { type: 'none' };
  const trimmed = rawContact.trim();
  if (!trimmed || trimmed.toLowerCase() === 'x') {
    return { type: 'none' };
  }
  if (/^mailto:/i.test(trimmed)) {
    const email = trimmed.replace(/^mailto:/i, '').split('?')[0].trim();
    if (email) {
      return {
        type: 'email',
        email,
        mailtoUrl: `mailto:${email}`,
        gmailUrl: `https://mail.google.com/mail/?view=cm&fs=1&to=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`,
      };
    }
  }
  if (/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(trimmed)) {
    return {
      type: 'email',
      email: trimmed,
      mailtoUrl: `mailto:${trimmed}`,
      gmailUrl: `https://mail.google.com/mail/?view=cm&fs=1&to=${encodeURIComponent(trimmed)}`,
    };
  }
  if (/^tel:/i.test(trimmed)) {
    const rawNumber = trimmed.replace(/^tel:/i, '').trim();
    const displayPhone = formatPhoneNumber(rawNumber);
    const cleanDigits = rawNumber.replace(/[^\d+]/g, '');
    const telDigits = cleanDigits.startsWith('+')
      ? cleanDigits
      : cleanDigits.length === 10
      ? `+1${cleanDigits}`
      : cleanDigits;
    return {
      type: 'phone',
      displayPhone,
      telUrl: `tel:${telDigits}`,
      rawPhone: rawNumber,
    };
  }
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) {
    return {
      type: 'url',
      url: trimmed,
    };
  }
  const digitCount = (trimmed.match(/\d/g) || []).length;
  if (digitCount >= 7 && !/[a-zA-Z]/.test(trimmed)) {
    const displayPhone = formatPhoneNumber(trimmed);
    const cleanDigits = trimmed.replace(/[^\d+]/g, '');
    const telDigits = cleanDigits.startsWith('+')
      ? cleanDigits
      : cleanDigits.length === 10
      ? `+1${cleanDigits}`
      : cleanDigits;
    return {
      type: 'phone',
      displayPhone,
      telUrl: `tel:${telDigits}`,
      rawPhone: trimmed,
    };
  }
  if (trimmed.includes('.') && !trimmed.includes(' ') && trimmed.length > 3) {
    return {
      type: 'url',
      url: ensureExternalUrl(trimmed),
    };
  }
  return { type: 'none' };
}
export function getTagStyle(tag: string): { color: string; background: string } {
  const t = (tag || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (t.includes('science')) {
    return { color: '#0f5c5c', background: '#d3efec' };
  }
  if (t.includes('craft')) {
    return { color: '#8a3d0c', background: '#fde4cf' };
  }
  if (t.includes('food') || t.includes('drink')) {
    return { color: '#6b5200', background: '#f4eab8' };
  }
  if (t.includes('community') || t.includes('social')) {
    return { color: '#3b4a54', background: '#e1e7ea' };
  }
  if (t.includes('music') || t.includes('bluegrass')) {
    return { color: '#5b2a86', background: '#ecdcf7' };
  }
  if (t.includes('trivia')) {
    return { color: '#2d3f7a', background: '#dde4f7' };
  }
  if (t.includes('open mic') || t.includes('mic') || t.includes('comedy')) {
    return { color: '#8a1f4f', background: '#fbdce9' };
  }
  if (t.includes('dance') || t.includes('salsa') || t.includes('bachata')) {
    return { color: '#852b2b', background: '#f9dede' };
  }
  if (t.includes('sport') || t.includes('fitness') || t.includes('yoga') || t.includes('walk')) {
    return { color: '#1f6a42', background: '#d7f0df' };
  }
  if (t.includes('language') || t.includes('english') || t.includes('spanish')) {
    return { color: '#2c4f7c', background: '#dbe5f7' };
  }
  return { color: '#4f483e', background: '#f3ead4' };
}
export function indexEvents(
  events: Event[],
  rollingWeek: Date[],
  currencyCode: string = 'USD'
): IndexedEvent[] {
  return events.map((ev) => {
    const parsedHour = parseHour(ev.startTime);
    const freeOrDonation = isFreeOrDonation(ev.price);
    const parsedPrice = freeOrDonation ? 0 : parseEventPrice(ev.price, currencyCode);
    const searchCorpus = [
      ev.title,
      ev.venue,
      ev.organization,
      ev.location,
      ev.area,
      ev.activity,
      ...ev.activities,
      ev.about,
      ev.notes,
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(' ')
      .toLowerCase();
    const activeDays = rollingWeek.map((day) => isEventActiveOnDate(ev, day));
    return {
      ...ev,
      parsedHour,
      parsedPrice,
      isFreeOrDonationPrice: freeOrDonation,
      searchCorpus,
      activeDays,
    };
  });
}
export function filterAndCountEvents(
  indexedEvents: IndexedEvent[],
  activeDayIdx: number,
  maxPrice: number,
  priceConfig: CityPriceConfig,
  selectedTimes: string[],
  selectedActivities: string[],
  selectedAreas: string[],
  searchQuery: string,
  timeGroups: { name: string; predicate: (h: number) => boolean }[]
): { currentList: IndexedEvent[]; dayCounts: number[] } {
  const dayCounts = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
  const currentList: IndexedEvent[] = [];
  const queryTerms = searchQuery.trim()
    ? searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
    : null;
  const selectedActivitiesLower =
    selectedActivities.length > 0
      ? selectedActivities.map((a) => a.toLowerCase())
      : null;
  const selectedAreasLower =
    selectedAreas.length > 0
      ? selectedAreas.map((a) => a.toLowerCase())
      : null;
  const isPriceFiltered = maxPrice < priceConfig.maxPrice;
  for (let i = 0; i < indexedEvents.length; i++) {
    const ev = indexedEvents[i];
    if (isPriceFiltered) {
      if (maxPrice === 0) {
        if (!ev.isFreeOrDonationPrice) continue;
      } else if (!ev.isFreeOrDonationPrice) {
        if (ev.parsedPrice === null || ev.parsedPrice > maxPrice) continue;
      }
    }
    if (selectedTimes.length > 0) {
      const matchesTime = selectedTimes.some((tgName) => {
        const group = timeGroups.find((g) => g.name === tgName);
        return group ? group.predicate(ev.parsedHour) : false;
      });
      if (!matchesTime) continue;
    }
    if (selectedActivitiesLower) {
      const hasActivityMatch = ev.activities.some((act) =>
        selectedActivitiesLower.includes(act.trim().toLowerCase())
      );
      if (!hasActivityMatch) continue;
    }
    if (selectedAreasLower) {
      const evAreaLower = (ev.area || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!selectedAreasLower.includes(evAreaLower)) continue;
    }
    if (queryTerms) {
      const matchesSearch = queryTerms.every((term) =>
        ev.searchCorpus.includes(term)
      );
      if (!matchesSearch) continue;
    }
    for (let d = 0; d < 7; d++) {
      if (ev.activeDays[d]) {
        dayCounts[d]++;
      }
    }
    if (ev.activeDays[activeDayIdx]) {
      currentList.push(ev);
    }
  }
  currentList.sort((a, b) => a.parsedHour - b.parsedHour);
  return { currentList, dayCounts };
}

export type CityPriceConfig = {

  underValue: number;
  underLabel: string;
  midLabel: string;

  linkHref: string;

export const DEFAULT_USD_PRICE_CONFIG: CityPriceConfig = {
  currencyCode: 'USD',
  currencySymbol: '$',
  unitSuffix: '',
  maxPrice: 50,
  step: 5,
  underValue: 10,
  underLabel: 'Under $10',
  midLabel: '$25',

export function getCityPriceConfig(city?: CityConfig): CityPriceConfig {
  if (city?.priceConfig) return city.priceConfig;
  if (city?.region?.toLowerCase().includes('colombia') || city?.slug?.includes('colombia')) {
    return CITIES['medellin-colombia'].priceConfig!;
  }
  return DEFAULT_USD_PRICE_CONFIG;
}
export function getCityBySlug(slug: string): CityConfig | undefined {
  if (!slug) return undefined;
  const normalized = slug.toLowerCase().trim();
  return CITIES[normalized];
}
export function getAllCitySlugs(): string[] {
  return Object.keys(CITIES);
}
export function getAllCities(): CityConfig[] {
  return Object.values(CITIES).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
}

  }

'use client';
import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import { Event } from '../../lib/google-sheets';
import {
  formatTimeRange,
  formatRecurrenceText,
  isFreePrice,
  ensureExternalUrl,
  getTagStyle,
  parseContactInfo,
} from '../utils';
import styles from './EventCard.module.css';
interface EventCardProps {
  event: Event;
  isOpen: boolean;
  isNextUp: boolean;
  cityName: string;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onOpenEdit: (ev: Event) => void;
}
function ActionButton({
  href,
  label,
  icon,
}: {
  href?: string;
  label: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  if (href) {
    return (
      <a
        href={ensureExternalUrl(href)}
        target="_blank"
        rel="noopener noreferrer"
        className={styles.actionBtnOutline}
      >
        {icon}
        {label}
      </a>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div
      className={styles.actionBtnOutline}
      style={{ opacity: 0.45, cursor: 'not-allowed' }}
    >
      {icon}
      {label}
    </div>
  );
}
function ContactButton({ contact }: { contact?: string }) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const popoverRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const contactInfo = useMemo(() => parseContactInfo(contact), [contact]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    function handleClickOutside(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (popoverRef.current && !popoverRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    }
    function handleKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isOpen]);
  const handleCopy = useCallback(async (text: string) => {
    try {
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      } else {
        const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
        textarea.value = text;
        textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
        textarea.style.opacity = '0';
        document.body.appendChild(textarea);
        textarea.focus();
        textarea.select();
        document.execCommand('copy');
        document.body.removeChild(textarea);
      }
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    } catch {
    }
  }, []);
  const contactIcon = (
    <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
      <rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="14" rx="2" />
      <path d="M3.5 6.5l8.5 6.5 8.5-6.5" />
    </svg>
  );
  if (contactInfo.type === 'none') {
    return (
      <div
        className={styles.actionBtnOutline}
        style={{ opacity: 0.45, cursor: 'not-allowed' }}
        aria-disabled="true"
      >
        {contactIcon}
        Contact
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (contactInfo.type === 'url') {
    return (
      <a
        href={contactInfo.url}
        target="_blank"
        rel="noopener noreferrer"
        className={styles.actionBtnOutline}
      >
        {contactIcon}
        Contact
      </a>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className={styles.contactWrapper} ref={popoverRef}>
      <button
        type="button"
        className={`${styles.actionBtnOutline} ${isOpen ? styles.actionBtnOutlineActive : ''}`}
        onClick={() => setIsOpen((prev) => !prev)}
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        aria-haspopup="true"
      >
        {contactIcon}
        Contact
      </button>
      {isOpen && (
        <div className={styles.contactPopover} role="dialog" aria-label="Contact options">
          {contactInfo.type === 'email' && (
            <>
              <div className={styles.contactHeader}>
                <span className={styles.contactHeaderLabel}>Email</span>
                <div className={styles.contactInlineRow}>
                  <span className={styles.contactHeaderValue} title={contactInfo.email}>
                    {contactInfo.email}
                  </span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className={`${styles.copyIconBtn} ${copied ? styles.copyIconBtnCopied : ''}`}
                    onClick={() => handleCopy(contactInfo.email)}
                    title={copied ? 'Copied to clipboard' : 'Copy email'}
                    aria-label={copied ? 'Email copied to clipboard' : 'Copy email to clipboard'}
                  >
                    {copied ? (
                      <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                        <path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5" />
                      </svg>
                    ) : (
                      <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                        <rect x="9" y="9" width="13" height="13" rx="2" ry="2" />
                        <path d="M5 15H4a2 2 0 01-2-2V4a2 2 0 012-2h9a2 2 0 012 2v1" />
                      </svg>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={styles.contactDivider} />
              <div className={styles.contactActions}>
                <a
                  href={contactInfo.gmailUrl}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className={styles.contactActionLink}
                  onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
                >
                  <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                    <rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="14" rx="2" />
                    <path d="M3 7l9 6 9-6" />
                  </svg>
                  Open in Gmail
                </a>
                <a
                  href={contactInfo.mailtoUrl}
                  className={styles.contactActionLink}
                  onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
                >
                  <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                    <path d="M4 4h16c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2v12c0 1.1-.9 2-2 2H4c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V6c0-1.1.9-2 2-2z" />
                    <polyline points="22,6 12,13 2,6" />
                  </svg>
                  Default Mail App
                </a>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
          {contactInfo.type === 'phone' && (
            <>
              <div className={styles.contactHeader}>
                <span className={styles.contactHeaderLabel}>Phone</span>
                <div className={styles.contactInlineRow}>
                  <span className={styles.contactHeaderValue} title={contactInfo.displayPhone}>
                    {contactInfo.displayPhone}
                  </span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className={`${styles.copyIconBtn} ${copied ? styles.copyIconBtnCopied : ''}`}
                    onClick={() => handleCopy(contactInfo.displayPhone)}
                    title={copied ? 'Copied to clipboard' : 'Copy phone number'}
                    aria-label={copied ? 'Phone number copied to clipboard' : 'Copy phone number to clipboard'}
                  >
                    {copied ? (
                      <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                        <path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5" />
                      </svg>
                    ) : (
                      <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                        <rect x="9" y="9" width="13" height="13" rx="2" ry="2" />
                        <path d="M5 15H4a2 2 0 01-2-2V4a2 2 0 012-2h9a2 2 0 012 2v1" />
                      </svg>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={styles.contactDivider} />
              <div className={styles.contactActions}>
                <a
                  href={contactInfo.telUrl}
                  className={styles.contactActionLinkPrimary}
                  onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
                >
                  <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                    <path d="M22 16.92v3a2 2 0 01-2.18 2 19.79 19.79 0 01-8.63-3.07 19.5 19.5 0 01-6-6 19.79 19.79 0 01-3.07-8.67A2 2 0 014.11 2h3a2 2 0 012 1.72 12.84 12.84 0 00.7 2.81 2 2 0 01-.45 2.11L8.09 9.91a16 16 0 006 6l1.27-1.27a2 2 0 012.11-.45 12.84 12.84 0 002.81.7A2 2 0 0122 16.92z" />
                  </svg>
                  Call {contactInfo.displayPhone}
                </a>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
function EventCard({
  event,
  isOpen,
  isNextUp,
  cityName,
  onToggle,
  onOpenEdit,
}: EventCardProps) {
  const { start, end } = formatTimeRange(event.startTime, event.endTime);
  const isFree = isFreePrice(event.price);
  const tagList = event.activities || [];
  const displayVenue = event.venue || event.location;
  const recurrenceText = formatRecurrenceText(event.frequency, event.frequencyNotes);
  return (
    <div className={`${styles.eventCard} ${isOpen ? styles.eventCardOpen : ''}`}>
      <button
        type="button"
        className={styles.cardRow}
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        onClick={onToggle}
      >
        <div className={styles.timeCol}>
          {start}
          {end && <div className={styles.endTimeText}>to {end}</div>}
        </div>
        <div className={styles.infoCol}>
          {isNextUp && <span className={styles.nextUpBadge}>Next up</span>}
          <div className={styles.eventTitle}>
            {event.title}
            {event.organization && event.organization !== displayVenue && (
              <span className={styles.eventHost}> w/ {event.organization}</span>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className={styles.eventLocation}>
            {displayVenue}
            {event.area ? ` · ${event.area}` : ''}
          </div>
          {event.price ? (
            <div className={`${styles.priceLine} ${isFree ? styles.priceFree : styles.pricePaid}`}>
              <svg
                width="15"
                height="15"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2.2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
              >
                <path d="M3 12V4h8l10 10-8 8L3 12z" />
                <circle cx="7.5" cy="8.5" r="1" />
              </svg>
              {event.price}
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {tagList.length > 0 && (
            <div className={styles.tagList}>
              {tagList.map((tag) => {
                const customStyle = getTagStyle(tag);
                return (
                  <span
                    key={tag}
                    className={styles.tagChip}
                    style={{
                      color: customStyle.color,
                      backgroundColor: customStyle.background,
                    }}
                  >
                    {tag}
                  </span>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={`${styles.chevronCircle} ${
            isOpen ? styles.chevronCircleOpen : ''
          }`}
        >
          <svg
            width="16"
            height="16"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="2.4"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          >
            <path d={isOpen ? 'M6 15l6-6 6 6' : 'M6 9l6 6 6-6'} />
          </svg>
        </span>
      </button>
      {isOpen && (
        <div className={styles.expandedDrawer}>
          {(event.about || event.notes) && (
            <p className={styles.eventDescription}>{event.about || event.notes}</p>
          )}
          {recurrenceText && (
            <p
              className={styles.eventDescription}
              style={{
                fontWeight: 600,
                color: 'var(--ink)',
                marginBottom: event.preRegistration ? 8 : 14,
              }}
            >
              📅 {recurrenceText}
            </p>
          )}
          {event.preRegistration && (
            <p
              className={styles.eventDescription}
              style={{
                fontWeight: 600,
                color: 'var(--ink)',
                marginBottom: 14,
              }}
            >
              📝 {event.preRegistration}
            </p>
          )}
          <div className={styles.drawerActionRow}>
            <div className={styles.buttonGrid4}>
              <a
                href={
                  event.map
                    ? ensureExternalUrl(event.map)
                    : `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(
                        `${displayVenue}, ${cityName}`
                      )}`
                }
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className={styles.actionBtnPrimary}
                aria-label="Open in Maps"
              >
                <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                  <path d="M12 21s-7-6.2-7-11a7 7 0 0114 0c0 4.8-7 11-7 11z" />
                  <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="2.5" />
                </svg>
                Maps
              </a>
              <ActionButton
                href={event.website}
                label="Website"
                icon={
                  <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" />
                    <path d="M3 12h18M12 3c3 3.2 3 14.8 0 18M12 3c-3 3.2-3 14.8 0 18" />
                  </svg>
                }
              />
              <ActionButton
                href={event.social}
                label="Instagram"
                icon={
                  <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                    <rect x="3.5" y="3.5" width="17" height="17" rx="5" />
                    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4" />
                    <circle cx="17.2" cy="6.8" r=".6" />
                  </svg>
                }
              />
              <ContactButton contact={event.contact} />
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={styles.suggestEditBtn}
              onClick={() => onOpenEdit(event)}
            >
              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                <path d="M4 20l1-4L16.5 4.5a2 2 0 013 3L8 19l-4 1z" />
              </svg>
              Suggest edit
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
export default memo(EventCard);

================
File: app/events/CityEventsView.tsx
================
'use client';
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useDeferredValue, useCallback } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { CityConfig, getAllCities, getCityPriceConfig } from '../lib/cities';
import { getEvents, Event } from '../lib/google-sheets';
import {
  parseHour,
  indexEvents,
  filterAndCountEvents,
  IndexedEvent,
} from './utils';
import Header from '../components/Header';
import Footer from '../components/Footer';
import DayPicker from './components/DayPicker';
import FilterControls from './components/FilterControls';
import EventCard from './components/EventCard';
import SuggestEditModal from './components/SuggestEditModal';
import CityHeroCard from './components/CityHeroCard';
import styles from './EventsView.module.css';
const DAY_NAMES_LONG = [
  'Sunday',
  'Monday',
  'Tuesday',
  'Wednesday',
  'Thursday',
  'Friday',
  'Saturday',
];
const MONTH_NAMES = [
  'Jan',
  'Feb',
  'Mar',
  'Apr',
  'May',
  'Jun',
  'Jul',
  'Aug',
  'Sep',
  'Oct',
  'Nov',
  'Dec',
];
const TIME_GROUPS = [
  { name: 'Morning', predicate: (h: number) => h < 12 },
  { name: 'Afternoon', predicate: (h: number) => h >= 12 && h < 17 },
  { name: 'Evening', predicate: (h: number) => h >= 17 && h < 20 },
  { name: 'Night', predicate: (h: number) => h >= 20 },
];
export default function CityEventsView({
  city,
  initialEvents = [],
}: {
  city: CityConfig;
  initialEvents?: Event[];
}) {
  const priceConfig = useMemo(() => getCityPriceConfig(city), [city]);
  const [allEvents, setAllEvents] = useState<Event[]>(initialEvents);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(initialEvents.length === 0);
  const [activeDayIdx, setActiveDayIdx] = useState(0);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const deferredSearchQuery = useDeferredValue(searchQuery);
  const [maxPrice, setMaxPrice] = useState<number>(priceConfig.maxPrice);
  const [selectedTimes, setSelectedTimes] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedActivities, setSelectedActivities] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedAreas, setSelectedAreas] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [openEventId, setOpenEventId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editModalEvent, setEditModalEvent] = useState<Event | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    setMaxPrice(priceConfig.maxPrice);
  }, [priceConfig]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialEvents.length === 0) {
      setLoading(true);
      getEvents(city)
        .then((data) => {
          setAllEvents(data);
        })
        .finally(() => setLoading(false));
    } else {
      setAllEvents(initialEvents);
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [city, initialEvents]);
  const rollingWeek = useMemo(() => {
    const today = new Date();
    return Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => {
      const d = new Date(today);
      d.setDate(today.getDate() + i);
      return d;
    });
  }, []);
  const indexedEvents = useMemo(() => {
    return indexEvents(allEvents, rollingWeek, priceConfig.currencyCode);
  }, [allEvents, rollingWeek, priceConfig.currencyCode]);
  const activeDate = rollingWeek[activeDayIdx] || rollingWeek[0];
  const now = new Date();
  const nowHour = now.getHours() + now.getMinutes() / 60;
  const activityFrequencies = useMemo(() => {
    const counts = new Map<string, number>();
    allEvents.forEach((ev) => {
      ev.activities.forEach((act) => {
        const trimmed = act.trim();
        if (trimmed) {
          counts.set(trimmed, (counts.get(trimmed) || 0) + 1);
        }
      });
    });
    return counts;
  }, [allEvents]);
  const activities = useMemo(() => {
    return Array.from(activityFrequencies.keys()).sort((a, b) => {
      const countDiff = (activityFrequencies.get(b) || 0) - (activityFrequencies.get(a) || 0);
      if (countDiff !== 0) return countDiff;
      return a.localeCompare(b);
    });
  }, [activityFrequencies]);
  const areas = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    allEvents.forEach((ev) => {
      if (ev.area && ev.area.trim().length > 0 && ev.area.trim().length < 35) {
        set.add(ev.area.trim());
      }
    });
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [allEvents]);
  const toggleTime = useCallback((tName: string) => {
    setSelectedTimes((prev) =>
      prev.includes(tName) ? prev.filter((t) => t !== tName) : [...prev, tName]
    );
  }, []);
  const toggleActivity = useCallback((act: string) => {
    setSelectedActivities((prev) =>
      prev.includes(act) ? prev.filter((a) => a !== act) : [...prev, act]
    );
  }, []);
  const handleSelectChip = useCallback((act: string) => {
    setSelectedActivities((prev) => {
      if (prev.includes(act)) {
        return prev.filter((a) => a !== act);
      }
      return [act];
    });
  }, []);
  const toggleArea = useCallback((ar: string) => {
    setSelectedAreas((prev) =>
      prev.includes(ar) ? prev.filter((a) => a !== ar) : [...prev, ar]
    );
  }, []);
  const { currentList, dayCounts } = useMemo(() => {
    return filterAndCountEvents(
      indexedEvents,
      activeDayIdx,
      maxPrice,
      priceConfig,
      selectedTimes,
      selectedActivities,
      selectedAreas,
      deferredSearchQuery,
      TIME_GROUPS
    );
  }, [
    indexedEvents,
    activeDayIdx,
    maxPrice,
    priceConfig,
    selectedTimes,
    selectedActivities,
    selectedAreas,
    deferredSearchQuery,
  ]);
  const nextUpEventId = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeDayIdx !== 0) return null;
    const nextEvent = currentList.find((ev) => ev.parsedHour >= nowHour);
    return nextEvent ? nextEvent.id || nextEvent.title : null;
  }, [activeDayIdx, currentList, nowHour]);
  const hasActiveFilters =
    searchQuery.trim().length > 0 ||
    maxPrice < priceConfig.maxPrice ||
    selectedTimes.length > 0 ||
    selectedActivities.length > 0 ||
    selectedAreas.length > 0;
  const clearAllFilters = useCallback(() => {
    setSearchQuery('');
    setMaxPrice(priceConfig.maxPrice);
    setSelectedTimes([]);
    setSelectedActivities([]);
    setSelectedAreas([]);
  }, [priceConfig.maxPrice]);
  const allCityOptions = useMemo(() => getAllCities(), []);
  const totalEventsCount = allEvents.length || initialEvents.length;
  const dayHeading =
    activeDayIdx === 0
      ? 'Today'
      : activeDayIdx === 1
      ? 'Tomorrow'
      : DAY_NAMES_LONG[activeDate.getDay()];
  const daySubheading = `${DAY_NAMES_LONG[activeDate.getDay()]}, ${activeDate.getDate()} ${
    MONTH_NAMES[activeDate.getMonth()]
  } · ${currentList.length} ${currentList.length === 1 ? 'thing' : 'things'} on`;
  return (
    <div className={styles.pageContainer}>
      <Header
        city={city}
        allCityOptions={allCityOptions}
      />
      <div className={styles.heroWrapper}>
        {city.alertBanner && (
          <div className={styles.alertBanner} role="status">
            <span className={styles.alertBannerIcon} aria-hidden="true">
              <svg
                width="18"
                height="18"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2.2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
              >
                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
                <line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="12" />
                <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16" />
              </svg>
            </span>
            <span className={styles.alertBannerText}>
              {city.alertBanner.message}{' '}
              <Link href={city.alertBanner.linkHref} className={styles.alertBannerLink}>
                {city.alertBanner.linkText}
              </Link>
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
        <CityHeroCard
          cityName={city.name}
          introTitle={city.introTitle}
          introDescription={city.introDescription}
          eventCount={totalEventsCount}
          activities={activities}
          selectedActivities={selectedActivities}
          onSelectChip={handleSelectChip}
          onClearActivities={() => setSelectedActivities([])}
        />
      </div>
      <main className={styles.mainLayout}>
        <aside className={styles.aside}>
          <h2 className={styles.asideTitle}>{dayHeading}</h2>
          <p className={styles.asideSubtitle}>{daySubheading}</p>
          <DayPicker
            rollingWeek={rollingWeek}
            activeDayIdx={activeDayIdx}
            onSelectDay={(idx) => {
              setActiveDayIdx(idx);
              setOpenEventId(null);
            }}
            dayCounts={dayCounts}
          />
          <FilterControls
            searchQuery={searchQuery}
            onSearchChange={setSearchQuery}
            priceConfig={priceConfig}
            maxPrice={maxPrice}
            onPriceChange={setMaxPrice}
            timeSections={TIME_GROUPS.map((g) => g.name)}
            selectedTimes={selectedTimes}
            onToggleTime={toggleTime}
            onClearTimes={() => setSelectedTimes([])}
            activities={activities}
            selectedActivities={selectedActivities}
            onToggleActivity={toggleActivity}
            onClearActivities={() => setSelectedActivities([])}
            areas={areas}
            selectedAreas={selectedAreas}
            onToggleArea={toggleArea}
            onClearAreas={() => setSelectedAreas([])}
            hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
            onClearAllFilters={clearAllFilters}
          />
        </aside>
        <section className={styles.contentCol}>
          {loading ? (
            <div className={styles.emptyState}>
              <b className={styles.emptyStateTitle}>Loading {city.name} events...</b>
              Gathering up-to-date weekly community activities.
            </div>
          ) : currentList.length === 0 ? (
            <div className={styles.emptyState}>
              <b className={styles.emptyStateTitle}>
                Nothing listed{hasActiveFilters ? ' with these filters' : ''}
              </b>
              {hasActiveFilters
                ? 'Try clearing your filters to see more events.'
                : 'Know an event or group happening on this day? Submit it above.'}
            </div>
          ) : (
            TIME_GROUPS.map((group) => {
              const groupEvents = currentList.filter((ev) =>
                group.predicate(ev.parsedHour)
              );
              if (groupEvents.length === 0) return null;
              return (
                <div key={group.name}>
                  <div className={styles.timeGroupHeader}>
                    {group.name}
                    <div className={styles.timeGroupLine} />
                  </div>
                  {groupEvents.map((ev, i) => {
                    const uniqueId = ev.id || `${ev.title}-${i}`;
                    return (
                      <EventCard
                        key={uniqueId}
                        event={ev}
                        isOpen={openEventId === uniqueId}
                        isNextUp={uniqueId === nextUpEventId}
                        cityName={city.name}
                        onToggle={() =>
                          setOpenEventId(openEventId === uniqueId ? null : uniqueId)
                        }
                        onOpenEdit={setEditModalEvent}
                      />
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              );
            })
          )}
        </section>
      </main>
      <Footer />
      {editModalEvent && (
        <SuggestEditModal
          event={editModalEvent}
          cityName={city.name}
          onClose={() => setEditModalEvent(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: app/lib/google-sheets.ts
================
import { CityConfig, CITIES, MAIN_SPREADSHEET_ID } from './cities';
import { normalizeDayOfWeek } from '../events/utils';
export type Event = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  venue: string;
  organization: string;
  location: string;
  area: string;
  activity: string;
  activities: string[];
  dayOfWeek: string;
  startTime: string;
  endTime: string;
  frequency: string;
  frequencyNotes: string;
  price: string;
  preRegistration: string;
  map: string;
  social: string;
  website: string;
  contact: string;
  about: string;
  notes: string;
  database: string;
};
const BASE_PUB_URL = 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vS2zEDH8-8__S6s0_a0evopp5lh0e34Tv0_fPcPQetnhed1kXHCCGNhIsXen_za-xB8SpS9CIdZaH9C/pub';
const eventCache = new Map<string, { timestamp: number; data: Event[] }>();
const CACHE_TTL_MS = 60 * 1000;
function getCandidateUrls(city: CityConfig): string[] {
  if (city.csvUrl) return [city.csvUrl];
  const targetId = city.spreadsheetId || MAIN_SPREADSHEET_ID;
  const urls: string[] = [];
  urls.push(
    `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${targetId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&sheet=${encodeURIComponent(
      city.sheetTab
    )}`
  );
  if (city.sheetGid) {
    urls.push(
      `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${targetId}/export?format=csv&gid=${city.sheetGid}`
    );
    urls.push(
      `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${targetId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&gid=${city.sheetGid}`
    );
  }
  if (city.sheetTab.toLowerCase() === 'medellin') {
    urls.push(
      `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${targetId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&sheet=${encodeURIComponent(
        'Medellín'
      )}`
    );
  } else if (city.sheetTab.toLowerCase() === 'fort collins') {
    urls.push(
      `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${targetId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&sheet=FortCollins`
    );
  }
  urls.push(
    `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${targetId}/gviz/tq?sheet=${encodeURIComponent(
      city.sheetTab
    )}`
  );
  if (city.sheetGid) {
    urls.push(`${BASE_PUB_URL}?gid=${city.sheetGid}&single=true&output=csv`);
  }
  urls.push(
    `${BASE_PUB_URL}?sheet=${encodeURIComponent(city.sheetTab)}&single=true&output=csv`
  );
  return urls;
}
function parseCsv(csvText: string): string[][] {
  const rows: string[][] = [];
  let currentRow: string[] = [];
  let currentField = '';
  let inQuotes = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < csvText.length; i++) {
    const char = csvText[i];
    if (char === '"') {
      if (inQuotes && csvText[i + 1] === '"') {
        currentField += '"';
        i++;
      } else {
        inQuotes = !inQuotes;
      }
    } else if (char === ',' && !inQuotes) {
      currentRow.push(currentField);
      currentField = '';
    } else if ((char === '\n' || char === '\r') && !inQuotes) {
      currentRow.push(currentField);
      rows.push(currentRow);
      currentRow = [];
      currentField = '';
      if (char === '\r' && csvText[i + 1] === '\n') {
        i++;
      }
    } else {
      currentField += char;
    }
  }
  currentRow.push(currentField);
  rows.push(currentRow);
  return rows;
}
function parseSheetData(rawText: string): string[][] {
  const trimmed = rawText.trim();
  if (trimmed.includes('google.visualization.Query.setResponse') || trimmed.startsWith('/*O_o*/')) {
    try {
      const startIdx = trimmed.indexOf('{');
      const endIdx = trimmed.lastIndexOf('}');
      if (startIdx !== -1 && endIdx !== -1) {
        const jsonStr = trimmed.substring(startIdx, endIdx + 1);
        const data = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
        if (data.status === 'error') {
          return [];
        }
        if (data.table) {
          const cols: { label?: string; id?: string }[] = data.table.cols || [];
          const headerRow: string[] = cols.map((col) => col.label || col.id || '');
          const dataRows: string[][] = (data.table.rows || []).map((row: { c?: ({ v?: unknown; f?: string } | null)[] }) => {
            return (row.c || []).map((cell) => {
              if (!cell || cell.v === null || cell.v === undefined) return '';
              return String(cell.f || cell.v).trim();
            });
          });
          if (headerRow.some((h: string) => Boolean(h && !h.match(/^[A-Z]$/)))) {
            return [headerRow, ...dataRows];
          } else if (dataRows.length > 0) {
            return dataRows;
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[Someplace Social] Failed to parse GViz JSON, falling back to CSV parser:', e);
    }
  }
  return parseCsv(rawText);
}
const normalizeHeader = (header: string): string => header.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
const HEADER_ALIASES: Record<string, string[]> = {
  id: ['id'],
  title: ['title', 'eventname', 'name'],
  venue: ['venue', 'place'],
  organization: ['organization', 'organizer', 'host'],
  location: ['location', 'address'],
  area: ['area', 'neighborhood'],
  activity: ['activity', 'activities'],
  activity1: ['activity1', 'activity'],
  activity2: ['activity2'],
  activity3: ['activity3'],
  dayOfWeek: ['dayofweek', 'day', 'days', 'daysofweek'],
  startTime: ['starttime', 'start'],
  endTime: ['endtime', 'end'],
  frequency: ['frequency', 'cadence', 'recurrence', 'howoften'],
  frequencyNotes: [
    'frequencynotes',
    'frequencynote',
    'frequency_notes',
    'freqnotes',
    'freqnote',
    'frequencynot',
    'recurrencenotes',
  ],
  price: ['price', 'cost'],
  preRegistration: ['preregistration', 'prereg', 'registration', 'rsvp', 'preregister'],
  map: ['map', 'googlemap', 'googlemaplink', 'maps'],
  social: ['social', 'socialmedia', 'socialmedialink', 'instagram'],
  website: ['website', 'site', 'url'],
  contact: ['contact', 'whatsapp', 'phone'],
  about: ['about', 'description'],
  notes: ['notes', 'note'],
  database: ['database', 'db', 'sheet'],
};
const DEFAULT_INDEX_FALLBACK: Record<string, number> = {
  id: 0,
  title: 1,
  venue: 2,
  organization: 2,
  location: 3,
  area: 4,
  activity: 5,
  dayOfWeek: 6,
  startTime: 7,
  endTime: 8,
  frequency: 9,
  frequencyNotes: 10,
  price: 11,
  preRegistration: 12,
  map: 13,
  social: 14,
  website: 15,
  contact: 16,
  about: 17,
  notes: 18,
};
export async function getEvents(cityOrTab?: CityConfig | string): Promise<Event[]> {
  try {
    let cityConfig: CityConfig;
    if (typeof cityOrTab === 'string') {
      cityConfig = CITIES[cityOrTab] || {
        slug: cityOrTab.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-'),
        name: cityOrTab,
        region: '',
        heroLocation: cityOrTab,
        sheetTab: cityOrTab,
      };
    } else if (cityOrTab) {
      cityConfig = cityOrTab;
    } else {
      cityConfig = CITIES['medellin-colombia'];
    }
    const cached = eventCache.get(cityConfig.slug);
    if (cached && Date.now() - cached.timestamp < CACHE_TTL_MS) {
      return cached.data;
    }
    const candidateUrls = getCandidateUrls(cityConfig);
    const isDev = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development';
    let rows: string[][] = [];
    for (const url of candidateUrls) {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(url, {
          headers: {
            Accept: 'text/csv, application/json, text/plain, */*',
          },
          cache: isDev ? 'no-store' : 'default',
          next: isDev ? { revalidate: 0 } : { revalidate: 3600 },
        });
        if (response.ok) {
          const text = await response.text();
          const trimmed = text.trim();
          if (
            trimmed &&
            !trimmed.startsWith('<!DOCTYPE html') &&
            !trimmed.startsWith('<html') &&
            !trimmed.includes('accounts.google.com') &&
            !trimmed.includes('"status":"error"') &&
            !trimmed.includes('INVALID_QUERY')
          ) {
            const parsed = parseSheetData(trimmed);
            if (parsed.length >= 2) {
              rows = parsed;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (fetchErr) {
        console.warn(`[Someplace Social] Fetch error on ${url}:`, fetchErr);
      }
    }
    if (rows.length < 2) {
      console.warn(`[Someplace Social] No sheet data found for ${cityConfig.sheetTab}`);
      return [];
    }
    const headerRow = rows[0].map((h: string) => normalizeHeader(h));
    const headerIndexMap: Record<string, number> = {};
    Object.keys(HEADER_ALIASES).forEach((field) => {
      const aliases = HEADER_ALIASES[field];
      const foundIdx = headerRow.findIndex((h: string) => aliases.includes(h));
      if (foundIdx !== -1) {
        headerIndexMap[field] = foundIdx;
      }
    });
    const cleanCell = (cell: string): string => {
      const trimmed = (cell || '').trim();
      return trimmed.toLowerCase() === 'x' ? '' : trimmed;
    };
    const dataRows = rows.slice(1);
    const events = dataRows
      .map((row): Event | null => {
        if (row.length === 0 || row.every((cell) => cleanCell(cell) === '')) return null;
        const getValue = (field: string): string => {
          const colIdx = headerIndexMap[field] ?? DEFAULT_INDEX_FALLBACK[field];
          if (colIdx !== undefined && colIdx < row.length) {
            return cleanCell(row[colIdx]);
          }
          return '';
        };
        const venueVal = getValue('venue');
        const orgVal = getValue('organization');
        const locVal = getValue('location');
        const rawActivity = getValue('activity');
        const act1 = getValue('activity1');
        const act2 = getValue('activity2');
        const act3 = getValue('activity3');
        let parsedActivities: string[] = [];
        if (rawActivity) {
          parsedActivities = rawActivity.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        }
        if (parsedActivities.length === 0) {
          parsedActivities = [act1, act2, act3]
            .flatMap((s) => (s ? s.split(',').map((x) => x.trim()) : []))
            .filter(Boolean);
        }
        const uniqueActs: string[] = [];
        for (const act of parsedActivities) {
          if (!uniqueActs.some((u) => u.toLowerCase() === act.toLowerCase())) {
            uniqueActs.push(act);
          }
        }
        const activityStr = uniqueActs.join(', ');
        const rawDay = getValue('dayOfWeek');
        const dayOfWeekStr = normalizeDayOfWeek(rawDay);
        return {
          id: getValue('id'),
          title: getValue('title'),
          venue: venueVal,
          organization: orgVal || venueVal,
          location: locVal || venueVal,
          area: getValue('area'),
          activity: activityStr,
          activities: uniqueActs,
          dayOfWeek: dayOfWeekStr,
          startTime: getValue('startTime'),
          endTime: getValue('endTime'),
          frequency: getValue('frequency'),
          frequencyNotes: getValue('frequencyNotes'),
          price: getValue('price'),
          preRegistration: getValue('preRegistration'),
          map: getValue('map'),
          social: getValue('social'),
          website: getValue('website'),
          contact: getValue('contact'),
          about: getValue('about'),
          notes: getValue('notes'),
          database: getValue('database'),
        };
      })
      .filter((event): event is Event => event !== null);
    const validEvents = events.filter((event) => Boolean(event.title));
    eventCache.set(cityConfig.slug, { timestamp: Date.now(), data: validEvents });
    return validEvents;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching events:', error);
    return [];
  }
}

'use client';
import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { CityConfig, getAllCities } from '../lib/cities';
import styles from './Header.module.css';
interface HeaderProps {
  city?: CityConfig;
  allCityOptions?: CityConfig[];
}
export default function Header({
  city,
  allCityOptions,
}: HeaderProps) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [citiesMenuOpen, setCitiesMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [mobileDrawerOpen, setMobileDrawerOpen] = useState(false);
  const citiesMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const citiesList = useMemo(() => {
    const list = allCityOptions || getAllCities();
    return [...list].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  }, [allCityOptions]);
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (citiesMenuRef.current && !citiesMenuRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setCitiesMenuOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (mobileDrawerOpen) {
      const originalOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      return () => {
        document.body.style.overflow = originalOverflow;
      };
    }
  }, [mobileDrawerOpen]);
  const isAboutActive = pathname === '/' || pathname === '/about';
  const isContactActive = pathname === '/contact';
  const isCityActive = Boolean(city);
  return (
    <>
      <header className={styles.header}>
        <div className={styles.headerInner}>
          <div className={styles.brandCol}>
            <Link
              href={city ? `/events/${city.slug}` : '/'}
              className={styles.brandLogoLink}
            >
              <Image
                src="/images/logo.svg"
                alt="Someplace Social"
                width={540}
                height={150}
                priority
                className={styles.logoImage}
              />
            </Link>
            {city && (
              <div className={styles.brandSubtitle}>
                {city.heroLocation}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <nav className={styles.navDesktop}>
            <div className={styles.citiesWrapper} ref={citiesMenuRef}>
              <button
                type="button"
                className={`${styles.citiesBtn} ${isCityActive ? styles.citiesBtnActive : ''}`}
                aria-expanded={citiesMenuOpen}
                onClick={() => setCitiesMenuOpen(!citiesMenuOpen)}
              >
                Cities
                <svg
                  width="14"
                  height="14"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  strokeWidth="2.4"
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                >
                  <path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" />
                </svg>
              </button>
              <div
                className={`${styles.citiesDropdown} ${
                  citiesMenuOpen ? '' : styles.citiesDropdownHidden
                }`}
              >
                {citiesList.map((c) => {
                  const isActive = city?.slug === c.slug;
                  return (
                    <Link
                      key={c.slug}
                      href={`/events/${c.slug}`}
                      className={`${styles.cityOption} ${
                        isActive ? styles.cityOptionActive : ''
                      }`}
                      onClick={() => setCitiesMenuOpen(false)}
                    >
                      <span className={styles.cityName}>{c.name}</span>
                      {isActive && (
                        <svg
                          width="16"
                          height="16"
                          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                          fill="none"
                          stroke="currentColor"
                          strokeWidth="2.4"
                          strokeLinecap="round"
                          strokeLinejoin="round"
                        >
                          <path d="M5 12.5l4.5 4.5L19 7.5" />
                        </svg>
                      )}
                    </Link>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
            <Link
              href="/"
              className={`${styles.navLink} ${isAboutActive ? styles.navLinkActive : ''}`}
            >
              About
            </Link>
            <Link
              href="/contact"
              className={`${styles.navLink} ${isContactActive ? styles.navLinkActive : ''}`}
            >
              Contact
            </Link>
            <Link href="/contact?tab=submit" className={styles.addEventBtn}>
              +Add Event
            </Link>
          </nav>
          <div className={styles.navMobileActions}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={styles.hamburgerBtn}
              aria-label="Open menu"
              onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(true)}
            >
              <svg
                width="24"
                height="24"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2.2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
              >
                <path d="M4 7h16M4 12h16M4 17h16" />
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>
      {mobileDrawerOpen && (
        <div
          className={styles.drawerBackdrop}
          onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(false)}
        >
          <div
            className={styles.drawer}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
          >
            <div className={styles.drawerHeader}>
              <div className={styles.drawerTitle}>Someplace Social</div>
              <button
                type="button"
                className={styles.drawerCloseBtn}
                aria-label="Close menu"
                onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(false)}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.drawerSectionTitle}>Choose City</div>
            <div className={styles.drawerCityList}>
              {citiesList.map((c) => {
                const isActive = city?.slug === c.slug;
                return (
                  <Link
                    key={c.slug}
                    href={`/events/${c.slug}`}
                    className={`${styles.drawerCityItem} ${
                      isActive ? styles.drawerCityItemActive : ''
                    }`}
                    onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(false)}
                  >
                    <span>{c.name}</span>
                    {isActive && <span>✓</span>}
                  </Link>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            <div className={styles.drawerSectionTitle}>Navigation</div>
            <div className={styles.drawerNavLinks}>
              <Link
                href="/"
                className={`${styles.drawerNavLink} ${
                  isAboutActive ? styles.drawerNavLinkActive : ''
                }`}
                onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(false)}
              >
                About
              </Link>
              <Link
                href="/contact"
                className={`${styles.drawerNavLink} ${
                  isContactActive ? styles.drawerNavLinkActive : ''
                }`}
                onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(false)}
              >
                Contact
              </Link>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.drawerFooter}>
              <Link
                href="/contact?tab=submit"
                className={styles.drawerAddEventBtn}
                onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(false)}
              >
                +Add Event
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
